description: §14.8.10 (S456) — a program-body `?{CREATE TEMP TABLE staging (…, tenant_id TEXT)}`. A temporary table cannot be declared in `<schema>` (E-SCHEMA-014), so it was never in the tenant set and its reads were unscoped (g-tenant-small-residuals-s455 residual (a); compiled clean on 2dd6d35d9). Now refused at compile.
rationale: §14.8.10 (ruling user-voice-scrml.md S456 "b, startup check lands with it"): a program-body `?{CREATE [TEMP|TEMPORARY] TABLE … tenant_id …}` whose table is outside the compilation's tenant set is E-TENANT-UNDECLARED.
